map.手边没有金融计算器时，快速估算持有到期的年化回报。: For quickly estimating the annualised return to maturity when no financial calculator is at hand.
map.期限越长、价格偏离面值越大，误差越大。它用平均账面额代替真实现金流现值，并忽略票: The longer the term and the further the price is from the face value, the larger the error. It uses an average book value instead of the real present value of the cash flows and ignores coupon reinvestment; when you need a precise value, back it out with a bond pricing tool or solve the IRR of the cash flows.

map.近似公式什么时候误差最大？: When is the error of the approximate formula largest?
map.近似公式忽略现金流时间结构，年期长时误差略大；精确 YTM 需解方程，近似用于快: The approximate formula ignores the time structure of the cash flows, so the error grows a little for long terms; the exact YTM needs an equation to solve, and the approximation is enough for quick comparison.
map.近似和精确差多少？: How much do the approximate and exact values differ?
map.：YTM ≈ (50+(1000−950)/10)/((1000+950)/2): : YTM ≈ (50+(1000-950)/10)/((1000+950)/2) = (50+5)/975 = 5.64%. Buying at a discount pushes the YTM above the 5% coupon rate.
map.：YTM≈[50+(1000−950)/5]/[(1000+950)/2]=60: : YTM≈[50+(1000-950)/5]/[(1000+950)/2]=60/975≈6.15% (the page shows two decimals). Besides the 50 CNY coupon each year, it implies about 10 CNY a year of recovery of the face value.
